questions.text: यदि A = [aij] एक तत्समक आव्यूह है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: If A = [aij] is an identity matrix, then which of the following is true ?

options.A: aij = 1, यदि i ≠ j और 0, यदि i = j
options.B: aij = 1, सभी i, j के लिए
options.C: aij = 0, सभी i, j के लिए
options.D: aij = 1, यदि i = j और 0, यदि i ≠ j

options_english.A: aij = 1, if i ≠ j and 0, if i = j
options_english.D: aij = 1, if i = j and 0, if i ≠ j

questions.solution: In an identity matrix, every diagonal element (where row index equals column index, i.e., i = j) is 1, and every off-diagonal element (where i ≠ j) is 0. This is precisely what option (D) states: aij = 1 if i = j, and aij = 0 if i ≠ j. Option (A) reverses this condition, options (B) and (C) give only constant matrices.
questions.solution_hindi: एक तत्समक आव्यूह में, सभी विकर्ण अवयव (जहाँ i = j) का मान 1 होता है और सभी अविकर्ण अवयव (जहाँ i ≠ j) का मान 0 होता है। यही विकल्प (D) में दिया गया है।

questions.text: मान लो R+ सभी ऋणेतर वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय है। तब f : R+ → R+, f(x) = x² + 1 द्वारा परिभाषित फलन :
questions.text_english: Let R+ denote the set of all non-negative real numbers. Then the function f : R+ → R+ defined as f(x) = x² + 1 is :

options.A: एकैकी है परन्तु आच्छादक नहीं है
options.B: आच्छादक है परन्तु एकैकी नहीं है
options.D: न तो एकैकी है और न ही आच्छादक

questions.solution: For f(x) = x² + 1 on R+ (non-negative reals): It is one-one because if x₁² + 1 = x₂² + 1, then x₁ = x₂ for x₁, x₂ ≥ 0. However, it is not onto because the range of f is [1, ∞), which is a proper subset of R+ = [0, ∞). The value 0, for instance, is in the codomain R+ but has no pre-image. Therefore, f is one-one but not onto.
questions.solution_hindi: f(x) = x² + 1 के लिए R+ पर: यह एकैकी है क्योंकि x₁ = x₂ ≥ 0 के लिए f(x₁) = f(x₂) ⟹ x₁ = x₂। परन्तु परिसर [1, ∞) है जो R+ का उपसमुच्चय है, अतः यह आच्छादक नहीं है।

questions.text: मान लो A = [[a, b],[c, d]] एक वर्ग आव्यूह है जिसके लिए adj A = A है। तब, (a + b + c + d) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: Let A = [[a, b],[c, d]] be a square matrix such that adj A = A. Then, (a + b + c + d) is equal to :
questions.solution: For a 2×2 matrix A = [[a,b],[c,d]], adj A = [[d, -b],[-c, a]]. Given adj A = A, we have d = a, -b = b, -c = c, and a = d. From -b = b we get b = 0, and from -c = c we get c = 0. So a + b + c + d = a + 0 + 0 + a = 2a. Therefore the answer is (A) 2a.
questions.solution_hindi: 2×2 आव्यूह के लिए adj A = [[d,-b],[-c,a]]। adj A = A देने पर b = 0, c = 0 और d = a मिलता है। अतः a + b + c + d = 2a।

questions.text_english: A function f(x) = |1 – x + |x|| is :
questions.solution: For x ≥ 0: f(x) = |1 – x + x| = |1| = 1, which is constant and continuous. For x < 0: f(x) = |1 – x + (–x)| = |1 – 2x|, which is also continuous. At x = 0, both expressions give 1, so f is continuous there. At x = 1, f(1) = 1, continuous. Since f(x) = 1 for all x ≥ 0 and |1 – 2x| for x < 0 (continuous everywhere), f is continuous everywhere. The answer is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: x ≥ 0 के लिए f(x) = 1 (स्थिरांक), x < 0 के लिए f(x) = |1 – 2x| (संतत)। दोनों ओर से x = 0 पर सीमा 1 है, अतः f सर्वत्र संतत है।

questions.text: यदि एक वर्ग की भुजाएँ 1·5 cm/s की दर से घट रही हैं, तो इसके परिमाप के घटने की दर है :
questions.text_english: If the sides of a square are decreasing at the rate of 1·5 cm/s, the rate of decrease of its perimeter is :
questions.solution: Let the side of the square be x. Then perimeter P = 4x. Differentiating with respect to time t: dP/dt = 4 · (dx/dt). Given dx/dt = –1·5 cm/s (decreasing), so dP/dt = 4 × (–1·5) = –6 cm/s. The magnitude of the rate of decrease of perimeter is 6 cm/s. The answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: परिमाप P = 4x, अतः dP/dt = 4 × dx/dt = 4 × 1.5 = 6 cm/s। परिमाप घटने की दर 6 cm/s है।

questions.text: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0, यदि :
questions.text_english: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0, if :
questions.solution: By the property of definite integrals, ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0 when f is an odd function, i.e., when f(–x) = –f(x). This is because the positive and negative areas cancel each other. Option (A) describes an even function, for which the integral equals 2∫₀ᵃ f(x) dx, not 0. Therefore the answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0 तब होता है जब f विषम फलन हो, अर्थात् f(–x) = –f(x)। यह विकल्प (B) है।

questions.text: x log x (dy/dx) + y = 2 log x एक उदाहरण है :
questions.text_english: x log x dy/dx + y = 2 log x is an example of a :

options.A: पृथक्करणीय चर वाले अवकल समीकरण का
options.C: प्रथम कोटि के रैखिक अवकल समीकरण का
options.D: ऐसे अवकल समीकरण का जिसकी घात परिभाषित नहीं है

options_english.D: differential equation whose degree is not defined.

questions.solution: Rewriting the equation as dy/dx + y/(x log x) = 2/x, we see it is of the standard form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x), where P(x) = 1/(x log x) and Q(x) = 2/x. This is precisely the standard form of a first-order linear differential equation. The answer is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: समीकरण को dy/dx + y/(x log x) = 2/x रूप में लिखने पर यह dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) के मानक रूप में है, जो प्रथम कोटि का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है।

questions.text: यदि →a = 2î – ĵ + k̂ और →b = î + ĵ – k̂ हैं, तो →a और →b हैं :
questions.text_english: If →a = 2î – ĵ + k̂ and →b = î + ĵ – k̂, then →a and →b are :

options.A: सरेख सदिश जो कि समान्तर नहीं हैं

options_english.A: collinear vectors which are not parallel

questions.solution: To check if →a and →b are perpendicular, compute the dot product: →a · →b = (2)(1) + (–1)(1) + (1)(–1) = 2 – 1 – 1 = 0. Since the dot product is 0, the vectors are perpendicular. They are not parallel (ratios 2:1, –1:1, 1:–1 are not equal) and not unit vectors (|→a| = √6 ≠ 1). The answer is (C).

questions.text: यदि एक रेखा x, y और z अक्षों की धनात्मक दिशा के साथ क्रमश: α, β और γ कोण बनाती है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सत्य नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: If α, β and γ are the angles which a line makes with positive directions of x, y and z axes respectively, then which of the following is not true ?

options.D: cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1

options_english.D: cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1

questions.solution: We know that cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1 (A is true). Using sin²θ = 1 – cos²θ: sin²α + sin²β + sin²γ = 3 – (cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ) = 3 – 1 = 2 (B is true). Using cos 2θ = 2cos²θ – 1: cos 2α + cos 2β + cos 2γ = 2(cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ) – 3 = 2(1) – 3 = –1 (C is true). There is no general result that cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1; this is false. The answer is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1 से: sin²α + sin²β + sin²γ = 2 और cos 2α + cos 2β + cos 2γ = –1 सत्य हैं। परन्तु cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1 सामान्यतः सत्य नहीं है।

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या के उद्देश्य फलन में निर्णायक चरों पर लगे प्रतिबन्ध कहलाते हैं :
questions.text_english: The restrictions imposed on decision variables involved in an objective function of a linear programming problem are called :
questions.solution: In a linear programming problem, the restrictions or limitations placed on the decision variables are called constraints. Feasible solutions are those points that satisfy all constraints; optimal solutions are the best values of the objective function; infeasible solutions violate one or more constraints. The answer is (B) constraints.
questions.solution_hindi: रैखिक प्रोग्रामन में निर्णायक चरों पर लगी शर्तें/सीमाएं 'व्यवरोध' कहलाती हैं।

questions.text: मान लो E और F दो ऐसी घटनाएँ हैं जिनके लिए P(E) = 0·1, P(F) = 0·3, P(E ∪ F) = 0·4 है, तो P(F|E) है :
questions.text_english: Let E and F be two events such that P(E) = 0·1, P(F) = 0·3, P(E ∪ F) = 0·4, then P(F|E) is :
questions.solution: Using the addition formula: P(E ∩ F) = P(E) + P(F) – P(E ∪ F) = 0·1 + 0·3 – 0·4 = 0. Therefore P(F|E) = P(E ∩ F) / P(E) = 0 / 0·1 = 0. The events E and F are mutually exclusive since P(E ∩ F) = 0. The answer is (D).

questions.text: यदि A और B दो विषम सममित आव्यूह हैं, तो (AB + BA) एक :
questions.text_english: If A and B are two skew symmetric matrices, then (AB + BA) is :
questions.solution: Since A and B are skew symmetric, Aᵀ = –A and Bᵀ = –B. Now (AB + BA)ᵀ = (AB)ᵀ + (BA)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ + AᵀBᵀ = (–B)(–A) + (–A)(–B) = BA + AB = AB + BA. Since (AB + BA)ᵀ = AB + BA, the matrix AB + BA is symmetric. The answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: (AB + BA)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ + AᵀBᵀ = (–B)(–A) + (–A)(–B) = BA + AB = AB + BA। अतः AB + BA सममित आव्यूह है।

questions.text_english: If |1 3 1; k 0 1; 0 0 1| = ±6, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: Expanding the determinant along the third row: det = 0·(cofactor) – 0·(cofactor) + 1·(1·0 – k·3) = –3k. Setting |–3k| = 6 gives 3|k| = 6, so |k| = 2, meaning k = ±2. The answer is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: सारणिक को तीसरी पंक्ति के अनुदिश विस्तार करने पर: det = 1×(0 – 3k) = –3k। |–3k| = 6 से k = ±2।

questions.text: 2ˣ का अवकलज, 3ˣ के सापेक्ष, है :
questions.text_english: The derivative of 2ˣ w.r.t. 3ˣ is :
questions.solution: Let u = 2ˣ and v = 3ˣ. Then du/dx = 2ˣ log 2 and dv/dx = 3ˣ log 3. By the chain rule: du/dv = (du/dx)/(dv/dx) = (2ˣ log 2)/(3ˣ log 3) = (2/3)ˣ × (log 2/log 3). The answer is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: du/dv = (2ˣ log 2)/(3ˣ log 3) = (2/3)ˣ × (log 2/log 3)।

questions.text_english: If |→a| = 2 and –3 ≤ k ≤ 2, then |k→a| ∈ :
questions.solution: |k→a| = |k| × |→a| = 2|k|. Since –3 ≤ k ≤ 2, we have 0 ≤ |k| ≤ 3, so 0 ≤ 2|k| ≤ 6. Therefore |k→a| ∈ [0, 6]. Note that magnitude is always non-negative, so [–6, 4] is impossible. The answer is (D).

questions.text: यदि एक रेखा दोनों x-अक्ष और z-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशाओं में π/4 का कोण बनाती है, तो यह रेखा y-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशा में जो कोण बनाती है, वह है :
questions.text_english: If a line makes an angle of π/4 with the positive directions of both x-axis and z-axis, then the angle which it makes with the positive direction of y-axis is :
questions.solution: Using the relation cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1, with α = π/4 and γ = π/4: cos²(π/4) + cos²β + cos²(π/4) = 1, so (1/2) + cos²β + (1/2) = 1, giving cos²β = 0, hence β = π/2. The line makes an angle of π/2 with the positive y-axis. The answer is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: cos²(π/4) + cos²β + cos²(π/4) = 1 ⟹ 1/2 + cos²β + 1/2 = 1 ⟹ cos²β = 0 ⟹ β = π/2।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : प्रत्येक अदिश आव्यूह एक विकर्ण आव्यूह होता है।
तर्क (R) : एक विकर्ण आव्यूह में, विकर्ण के सभी अवयव शून्य होते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Every scalar matrix is a diagonal matrix.
Reason (R) : In a diagonal matrix, all the diagonal elements are 0.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled Assertion (A) and the other labelled Reason (R). Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is TRUE: A scalar matrix is of the form kI, where all diagonal elements are equal (= k) and all off-diagonal elements are 0. This satisfies the definition of a diagonal matrix (off-diagonal elements are 0), so every scalar matrix is indeed a diagonal matrix. Reason (R) is FALSE: In a diagonal matrix, the off-diagonal elements are 0, but the diagonal elements need not be 0 (they can be any values). The Reason incorrectly states that all diagonal elements are 0. Therefore (A) is true and (R) is false — answer is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि अदिश आव्यूह kI का रूप है जिसके अविकर्ण अवयव 0 हैं, यह विकर्ण आव्यूह है। तर्क (R) असत्य है क्योंकि विकर्ण आव्यूह में विकर्ण अवयव शून्य नहीं होते, केवल अविकर्ण अवयव शून्य होते हैं।

Reason (R) : Angle between →a and →b is same as angle between →b and →a numerically.

questions.solution: Projection of →a on →b = (→a · →b)/|→b| = |→a| cos θ, while projection of →b on →a = (→a · →b)/|→a| = |→b| cos θ. These are equal only when |→a| = |→b|. In general they are not equal. So Assertion (A) is FALSE. Reason (R) is TRUE: the angle between →a and →b is the same as the angle between →b and →a (angle is symmetric). The correct answer is (D).

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : sec²(tan⁻¹ 1/2) + cosec²(cot⁻¹ 1/3)
questions.text_english: Evaluate : sec²(tan⁻¹ 1/2) + cosec²(cot⁻¹ 1/3)

key_points: Use the identity sec²(tan⁻¹ x) = 1 + x² and cosec²(cot⁻¹ x) = 1 + x²

questions.solution: Let tan⁻¹(1/2) = θ, so tan θ = 1/2. Then sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ = 1 + 1/4 = 5/4. Let cot⁻¹(1/3) = φ, so cot φ = 1/3. Then cosec²φ = 1 + cot²φ = 1 + 1/9 = 10/9. Therefore sec²(tan⁻¹ 1/2) + cosec²(cot⁻¹ 1/3) = 5/4 + 10/9 = 45/36 + 40/36 = 85/36.

questions.text:

अथवा

OR
(b) Check the differentiability of f(x) = {x² + 1, 0 ≤ x < 1; 3 – x, 1 ≤ x ≤ 2} at x = 1.

key_points: (a) Take log: log x = x/y, so y = x/log x. Differentiate using quotient rule.
(b) LHD = lim(h→0⁻)[f(1+h)–f(1)]/h = –1; RHD = lim(h→0⁺)[f(1+h)–f(1)]/h = 2; LHD ≠ RHD so not differentiable.

questions.solution:
(a) Given x = eˣ/ʸ. Taking logarithm on both sides: log x = x/y, which gives y = x/log x. Differentiating using the quotient rule: dy/dx = [log x · d(x)/dx – x · d(log x)/dx] / (log x)² = [log x · 1 – x · (1/x)] / (log x)² = (log x – 1)/(log x)². Hence proved.

(b) f(1) = 3 – 1 = 2. LHD = lim(h→0⁻)[f(1+h) – f(1)]/h = lim[(1+h)² + 1 – 2]/h = lim[h² + 2h]/h = lim(h + 2) = 2. RHD = lim(h→0⁺)[f(1+h) – f(1)]/h = lim[(3–(1+h)) – 2]/h = lim(–h)/h = –1. Since LHD = 2 ≠ –1 = RHD, f is not differentiable at x = 1.
questions.solution_hindi: (क) x = eˣ/ʸ लेने पर log x = x/y, अतः y = x/log x। भागफल नियम से dy/dx = (log x – 1)/(log x)²। (ख) बायाँ अवकल = 2, दायाँ अवकल = –1। चूँकि दोनों बराबर नहीं, f, x = 1 पर अवकलनीय नहीं है।

questions.text:
(क) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^(π/2) sin 2x cos 3x dx
अथवा
(ख) दिया गया है d/dx F(x) = 1/√(2x – x²) और F(1) = 0, F(x) ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Evaluate : ∫₀^(π/2) sin 2x cos 3x dx
OR
(b) Given d/dx F(x) = 1/√(2x – x²) and F(1) = 0, find F(x).

key_points: (a) Use product-to-sum: sin 2x cos 3x = (1/2)[sin 5x + sin(–x)] = (1/2)(sin 5x – sin x). Integrate to get –2/5.
(b) F(x) = sin⁻¹(x–1), using F(1) = 0 to fix the constant.

questions.solution:
(a) Using the product-to-sum formula: sin 2x cos 3x = (1/2)[sin(2x+3x) + sin(2x–3x)] = (1/2)[sin 5x – sin x]. So ∫₀^(π/2) sin 2x cos 3x dx = (1/2)[–cos 5x/5 + cos x]₀^(π/2) = (1/2)[(–cos(5π/2)/5 + cos(π/2)) – (–cos 0/5 + cos 0)] = (1/2)[(0 + 0) – (–1/5 + 1)] = (1/2)[–4/5] = –2/5.

(b) F(x) = ∫ dx/√(2x – x²) = ∫ dx/√(1–(x–1)²) = sin⁻¹(x–1) + C. Using F(1) = 0: sin⁻¹(0) + C = 0 ⟹ C = 0. Therefore F(x) = sin⁻¹(x – 1).
questions.solution_hindi: (क) sin 2x cos 3x = (1/2)(sin 5x – sin x) का उपयोग करके समाकलन करने पर उत्तर –2/5 प्राप्त होता है। (ख) F(x) = sin⁻¹(x–1) + C और F(1) = 0 से C = 0, अतः F(x) = sin⁻¹(x–1)।

questions.text: बिन्दु A और B, जिनके स्थिति सदिश क्रमश: î + 2ĵ – k̂ और –î + ĵ + k̂ हैं, को मिलाने वाले रेखा-खंड को 4 : 1 के अनुपात से बाह्य विभाजित करने वाले बिन्दु C का स्थिति सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए। |→AB| : |→BC| भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the position vector of point C which divides the line segment joining points A and B having position vectors î + 2ĵ – k̂ and –î + ĵ + k̂ respectively in the ratio 4 : 1 externally. Further, find |→AB| : |→BC|.

key_points: External division formula: C = (m·→b – n·→a)/(m–n) with m=4, n=1

questions.solution: Using the external division formula, when C divides AB externally in ratio 4:1: →OC = (4·→OB – 1·→OA)/(4–1) = [4(–î+ĵ+k̂) – 1(î+2ĵ–k̂)]/3 = (–4î+4ĵ+4k̂ – î–2ĵ+k̂)/3 = (–5î+2ĵ+5k̂)/3. For the ratio |→AB|:|→BC|: Since C divides AB externally in ratio AC:CB = 4:1, we have |→AC|:|→BC| = 4:1, which means |→AB|:|→BC| = (AC–BC):BC = 3:1. Wait — for external division in ratio 4:1, AC/BC = 4/1, so |→AB| = |→AC – →BC| and since A, B, C are collinear with C outside: |→AB|:|→BC| = 3:4... Using section formula result: |→AB|:|→BC| = 1:4 (since B divides AC internally in ratio 1:3, i.e., AB:BC = 1:3 is not matching). The standard result for external division in ratio m:n is |→AB|:|→BC| = (m–n):m = 3:4. Therefore |→AB|:|→BC| = 3:4.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि →a और →b दो शून्येतर सदिश हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि |→a · →b| ≤ |→a||→b|। वह स्थिति लिखिए जिसमें |→a · →b| = |→a||→b| है।
questions.text_english: Let →a and →b be two non-zero vectors. Prove that |→a · →b| ≤ |→a||→b|. State the condition under which equality holds, i.e., |→a · →b| = |→a||→b|.

key_points: Equality holds when |cos θ| = 1, i.e., θ = 0 or π, meaning →a and →b are parallel (collinear).

questions.solution: By definition of the dot product, →a · →b = |→a||→b| cos θ, where θ is the angle between the vectors. Taking absolute values: |→a · →b| = |→a||→b||cos θ|. Since |cos θ| ≤ 1 for all real θ, it follows that |→a · →b| ≤ |→a||→b|. This is the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. Equality holds when |cos θ| = 1, i.e., when θ = 0 or θ = π, which means →a and →b are parallel (collinear).
questions.solution_hindi: →a · →b = |→a||→b| cos θ से |→a · →b| = |→a||→b||cos θ| ≤ |→a||→b|। समानता तब होती है जब θ = 0 या π, अर्थात →a और →b समान्तर हों।

questions.text:
(क) यदि x cos(p + y) + cos p sin(p + y) = 0 है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि cos p dy/dx = –cos²(p + y), जहाँ p स्थिरांक है।
अथवा
(ख) a और b के वे मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए फलन f, जो परिभाषित है : f(x) = {a|x–2|/(x–2) + a, यदि x < 2; a + b, यदि x = 2; b|x–2|/(x–2) + b, यदि x > 2} संतत फलन है।
questions.text_english:
(a) If x cos(p + y) + cos p sin(p + y) = 0, prove that cos p dy/dx = –cos²(p + y), where p is a constant.
OR
(b) Find the value of a and b so that function f defined as f(x) = {a + a|x–2|/(x–2), if x < 2; a+b, if x = 2; b + b|x–2|/(x–2), if x > 2} is a continuous function.

key_points: (a) Rearrange to cos(p+y)/sin(p+y) = –cos p/x, i.e., x = –cos p/cos(p+y) × sin(p+y). Differentiate implicitly.

(b) LHL at x=2: a + a(–1) = 0; RHL at x=2: b + b(1) = 2b; f(2) = a+b. For continuity: 0 = a+b = 2b, giving b=0 and a=0. But checking the original form: for x<2, |x–2|/(x–2) = –1 so f = a–a+a = a... let a=1, b=–1 gives consistency.

questions.solution:
(a) From x cos(p+y) + cos p sin(p+y) = 0, we get x = –cos p sin(p+y)/cos(p+y) = –cos p tan(p+y). Differentiating both sides with respect to x (treating p as constant): 1 = –cos p · sec²(p+y) · dy/dx. Therefore cos p · dy/dx = –cos²(p+y). Hence proved.

(b) For x < 2: |x–2| = –(x–2), so f(x) = a(–1) + a = 0 (using the form a·|x–2|/(x–2) + a). For x > 2: |x–2| = x–2, so f(x) = b(1) + b = 2b. For continuity at x = 2: LHL = 0, f(2) = a + b, RHL = 2b. So 0 = a + b and a + b = 2b, giving a + b = 0 and b = 0, thus a = 0. But this gives trivial solution. Interpreting the function as written in the paper: for x < 2, f(x) = a, for x = 2, f(x) = a+b, for x > 2, f(x) = b+b = 2b. Continuity requires: lim(x→2⁻) f(x) = a = a+b = lim(x→2⁺) f(x) = 2b. From a = 2b and a = a+b: b = 0, a = 0. The values are a = 0 and b = 0.
questions.solution_hindi: (क) x = –cos p tan(p+y) को x के सापेक्ष अवकलित करने पर 1 = –cos p sec²(p+y) dy/dx, अतः cos p dy/dx = –cos²(p+y)। (ख) LHL = a, f(2) = a+b, RHL = 2b। संतत होने के लिए a = a+b = 2b, जिससे a = 0, b = 0।

questions.text:
(क) अन्तराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिनमें फलन f(x) = (log x)/x निरन्तर वर्धमान या निरन्तर ह्रासमान है।
अथवा
(ख) अन्तराल [1, 2] में f(x) = x²/2 + 2/x द्वारा प्रदत्त फलन f के निरपेक्ष उच्चतम और निरपेक्ष निम्नतम मानों को ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the intervals in which the function f(x) = (log x)/x is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
OR
(b) Find the absolute maximum and absolute minimum values of the function f given by f(x) = x²/2 + 2/x, on the interval [1, 2].

key_points: (a) f'(x) = (1 – log x)/x². f'(x) > 0 when log x < 1, i.e., x < e: increasing on (0, e). f'(x) < 0 when x > e: decreasing on (e, ∞).

questions.solution:
(a) f(x) = (log x)/x, domain x > 0. f'(x) = [x·(1/x) – log x·1]/x² = (1 – log x)/x². f'(x) > 0 when 1 – log x > 0, i.e., log x < 1, i.e., x < e. f'(x) < 0 when x > e. Therefore f is strictly increasing on (0, e) and strictly decreasing on (e, ∞).

(b) f(x) = x²/2 + 2/x on [1, 2]. f'(x) = x – 2/x². Setting f'(x) = 0: x³ = 2, x = ∛2. f(1) = 1/2 + 2 = 5/2. f(∛2) = (∛4)/2 + 2/∛2 = (∛4)/2 + 2·∛4/2 = 3∛4/2. f(2) = 2 + 1 = 3. Now 3∛4/2 ≈ 3(1.587)/2 ≈ 2.38 < 5/2 = 2.5 < 3. Absolute minimum = 3∛4/2 at x = ∛2; absolute maximum = 3 at x = 2.
questions.solution_hindi: (क) f'(x) = (1–log x)/x²। f'(x) > 0 जब x < e (वर्धमान) और f'(x) < 0 जब x > e (ह्रासमान)। (ख) f(1) = 5/2, f(∛2) = 3∛4/2, f(2) = 3। निरपेक्ष उच्चतम = 3 (x=2 पर), निरपेक्ष निम्नतम = 3∛4/2 (x=∛2 पर)।

questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ (x² + 1)/[(x² + 2)(x² + 4)] dx
questions.text_english: Find : ∫ (x² + 1)/[(x² + 2)(x² + 4)] dx

key_points: Use partial fractions with substitution t = x²

questions.solution: Using partial fractions: (x²+1)/[(x²+2)(x²+4)] = A/(x²+2) + B/(x²+4). Multiplying through: x²+1 = A(x²+4) + B(x²+2). Putting x² = –2: –1 = 2A, so A = –1/2. Putting x² = –4: –3 = –2B, so B = 3/2. Therefore the integral = ∫[–1/2/(x²+2) + 3/2/(x²+4)]dx = (–1/2)·(1/√2)tan⁻¹(x/√2) + (3/2)·(1/2)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C = –(1/(2√2))tan⁻¹(x/√2) + (3/4)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C.

questions.text:
(क) ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ eˣ (2 + sin 2x)/(1 + cos 2x) dx
अथवा
(ख) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^(π/4) 1/(sin x + cos x) dx
questions.text_english:
(a) Find : ∫ eˣ (2 + sin 2x)/(1 + cos 2x) dx
OR
(b) Evaluate : ∫₀^(π/4) 1/(sin x + cos x) dx

key_points: (a) Use 1+cos2x=2cos²x and sin2x=2sinxcosx. Simplify to eˣ(sec²x + tanx). Use ∫eˣ[f(x)+f'(x)]dx = eˣf(x)+C with f(x)=tanx.
(b) sin x + cos x = √2 sin(x+π/4). Integral = (1/√2)∫₀^(π/4) cosec(x+π/4)dx = (1/√2)[ln|tan((x+π/4)/2 + π/4)|]₀^(π/4)

questions.solution:
(a) (2 + sin 2x)/(1 + cos 2x) = (2 + 2sin x cos x)/(2cos²x) = (1/cos²x) + (sin x/cos x) = sec²x + tan x. So the integral = ∫eˣ(tan x + sec²x)dx. Using the formula ∫eˣ[f(x)+f'(x)]dx = eˣf(x)+C with f(x) = tan x, f'(x) = sec²x: the answer is eˣ tan x + C.

(b) sin x + cos x = √2 sin(x + π/4). The integral = (1/√2)∫₀^(π/4) cosec(x+π/4)dx. Let u = x + π/4, du = dx: = (1/√2)∫_(π/4)^(π/2) cosec u du = (1/√2)[ln|tan(u/2)|]_(π/4)^(π/2) = (1/√2)[ln|tan(π/4)| – ln|tan(π/8)|] = (1/√2)[0 – ln(tan(π/8))] = (1/√2) ln cot(π/8) = (1/√2) ln(√2 + 1).
questions.solution_hindi: (क) (2+sin2x)/(1+cos2x) = sec²x + tanx। ∫eˣ(tanx+sec²x)dx = eˣ tanx + C। (ख) ∫₀^(π/4) dx/(sinx+cosx) = (1/√2)ln(√2+1)।

निम्नलिखित रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या को आलेख विधि से हल कीजिए :
निम्न व्यवरोधों के अन्तर्गत z = 4x + 3y का अधिकतमीकरण कीजिए :

questions.text_english:
Solve the following linear programming problem graphically :
Maximise z = 4x + 3y, subject to the constraints
x + y ≤ 800
2x + y ≤ 1000
x ≤ 400
x, y ≥ 0.
questions.solution: The feasible region is determined by plotting all constraints. The corner points of the feasible region are: O(0,0), A(400,0), B(400,200), C(200,600), D(0,800). Computing z = 4x + 3y at each: z(O) = 0, z(A) = 4(400)+3(0) = 1600, z(B) = 4(400)+3(200) = 1600+600 = 2200, z(C) = 4(200)+3(600) = 800+1800 = 2600, z(D) = 4(0)+3(800) = 2400. questions.text: P, Q और R के किसी कंपनी के CEO के रूप में चुने जाने की संभावनाएँ क्रमश: 4 : 1 : 2 के अनुपात में हैं। नए CEO, P, Q या R के तहत कंपनी के पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में लाभ बढ़ाने की प्रायिकताएँ क्रमश: 0·3, 0·8 और 0·5 हैं। यदि कंपनी पिछले वर्ष से लाभ बढ़ाती है, तो प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह R की CEO के पद पर नियुक्ति के कारण हुई है।
questions.text_english: The chances of P, Q and R getting selected as CEO of a company are in the ratio 4 : 1 : 2 respectively. The probabilities for the company to increase its profits from the previous year under the new CEO, P, Q or R are 0·3, 0·8 and 0·5 respectively. If the company increased the profits from the previous year, find the probability that it is due to the appointment of R as CEO.
questions.solution: Let E be the event that the company increases profit. P(P) = 4/7, P(Q) = 1/7, P(R) = 2/7. P(E|P) = 0.3, P(E|Q) = 0.8, P(E|R) = 0.5. By total probability theorem: P(E) = P(P)P(E|P) + P(Q)P(E|Q) + P(R)P(E|R) = (4/7)(0.3) + (1/7)(0.8) + (2/7)(0.5) = 1.2/7 + 0.8/7 + 1.0/7 = 3/7. By Bayes' theorem: P(R|E) = P(R)P(E|R)/P(E) = (2/7 × 0.5)/(3/7) = (1/7)/(3/7) = 1/3.

questions.text: समुच्चय A = {–4, –3, –2, –1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4} में, R = {(x, y) : x + y, 2 से भाज्य पूर्णांक है} द्वारा परिभाषित संबंध R है। दर्शाइए कि R एक तुल्यता संबंध है। तुल्यता-वर्ग [2] भी लिखिए।
questions.text_english: A relation R on set A = {–4, –3, –2, –1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4} be defined as R = {(x, y) : x + y is an integer divisible by 2}. Show that R is an equivalence relation. Also, write the equivalence class [2].

key_points: Reflexive: x+x = 2x divisible by 2 for all x ∈ A.
Symmetric: if x+y divisible by 2 then y+x = x+y also divisible by 2.
Transitive: if x+y and y+z divisible by 2 then x+z = (x+y)+(z–y)... use x+z = (x+y)+(y+z)–2y divisible by 2.

questions.solution:
Reflexive: For any x ∈ A, x + x = 2x, which is always divisible by 2. So (x, x) ∈ R for all x. R is reflexive.

Symmetric: Let (x, y) ∈ R, so x + y is divisible by 2. Since y + x = x + y, it is also divisible by 2. Thus (y, x) ∈ R. R is symmetric.

Transitive: Let (x, y) ∈ R and (y, z) ∈ R. Then x + y = 2m and y + z = 2n for some integers m, n. Adding: x + 2y + z = 2(m + n), so x + z = 2(m + n) – 2y = 2(m + n – y), which is divisible by 2. Thus (x, z) ∈ R. R is transitive.

Since R is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive, it is an equivalence relation.

Equivalence class [2]: [2] = {x ∈ A : x + 2 is divisible by 2} = {x ∈ A : x is even} = {–4, –2, 0, 2, 4}.
questions.solution_hindi: स्वतुल्य: x+x = 2x, 2 से विभाज्य। सममित: x+y विभाज्य ⟹ y+x विभाज्य। संक्रामक: x+y और y+z विभाज्य ⟹ x+z = (x+y)+(y+z)–2y विभाज्य। तुल्यता-वर्ग [2] = {–4, –2, 0, 2, 4}।

questions.text:
(क) दिया गया है कि फलन f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 स्थानीय उच्चतम मान x = 1 पर प्राप्त करता है। 'a' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए, और सभी अन्य बिन्दु ज्ञात कीजिए जिन पर इस फलन f(x) का स्थानीय उच्चतम या स्थानीय निम्नतम मान प्राप्त होता है।
अथवा
(ख) एक आयताकार धातु की चादर का परिमाप 300 cm है। एक सिलेंडर बनाने के लिए इसको एक किनारे से लपेटा जाता है। आयताकार चादर की विमाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे बनाए गए सिलेंडर का आयतन अधिकतम हो।
questions.text_english:
(a) It is given that function f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 attains local maximum value at x = 1. Find the value of 'a', hence obtain all other points where the given function f(x) attains local maximum or local minimum values.
OR
(b) The perimeter of a rectangular metallic sheet is 300 cm. It is rolled along one of its sides to form a cylinder. Find the dimensions of the rectangular sheet so that volume of cylinder so formed is maximum.

key_points: (b) Let breadth = x, length = l = 150–x. Radius r = x/(2π), height h = l = 150–x. V = πr²h = x²(150–x)/(4π). dV/dx = 0 gives x = 100. Dimensions: 100 cm × 100 cm.

questions.solution:
(a) Since f has local maximum at x = 1, f'(1) = 0. f'(x) = 4x³ – 124x + a. f'(1) = 4 – 124 + a = 0 gives a = 120. Now f'(x) = 4x³ – 124x + 120 = 4(x³ – 31x + 30). Factoring: since x = 1 is a root, divide to get 4(x–1)(x²+x–30) = 4(x–1)(x+6)(x–5). Critical points: x = 1, x = –6, x = 5. f''(x) = 12x² – 124. f''(1) = 12–124 = –112 < 0: local max at x = 1. f''(–6) = 12(36)–124 = 432–124 = 308 > 0: local min at x = –6. f''(5) = 12(25)–124 = 300–124 = 176 > 0: local min at x = 5.

(b) Let the length and breadth of the sheet be l and b respectively. Perimeter: 2(l+b) = 300, so l+b = 150. When rolled along breadth b: circumference = b = 2πr, radius r = b/(2π), height h = l = 150–b. Volume V = πr²h = π(b/(2π))²(150–b) = b²(150–b)/(4π). dV/db = [2b(150–b) – b²]/(4π) = b(300–3b)/(4π). dV/db = 0 when b = 100. Then l = 50. d²V/db² < 0 at b = 100, confirming maximum. Dimensions: length = 100 cm and breadth = 100 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: (क) f'(1) = 0 से a = 120। f'(x) = 4(x–1)(x+6)(x–5)। x=1 पर स्थानीय उच्चतम, x=–6 और x=5 पर स्थानीय निम्नतम। (ख) V = b²(150–b)/(4π) अधिकतम होता है b = 100 पर। विमाएँ: 100 cm × 100 cm।

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से, वृत्त x² + y² = 16 तथा रेखाओं x = –2 तथा x = 2 से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Using integration, find the area of the region enclosed between the circle x² + y² = 16 and the lines x = – 2 and x = 2.
questions.solution: The circle x² + y² = 16 has radius 4, centred at origin. The region lies between x = –2 and x = 2. By symmetry about x-axis, Area = 2∫₋₂² √(16–x²) dx. Using the standard formula ∫√(a²–x²)dx = (x/2)√(a²–x²) + (a²/2)sin⁻¹(x/a) + C with a = 4: Area = 2[x/2 · √(16–x²) + 8 sin⁻¹(x/4)]₋₂². At x = 2: 2/2 · √12 + 8 sin⁻¹(1/2) = √12 + 8(π/6) = 2√3 + 4π/3. At x = –2: –2/2 · √12 + 8 sin⁻¹(–1/2) = –2√3 + 8(–π/6) = –2√3 – 4π/3. Area = 2[(2√3 + 4π/3) – (–2√3 – 4π/3)] = 2[4√3 + 8π/3] = 8√3 + 16π/3 square units.
questions.solution_hindi: क्षेत्रफल = 2∫₋₂² √(16–x²) dx। मानक सूत्र प्रयुक्त करने पर क्षेत्रफल = 8√3 + 16π/3 वर्ग इकाई।

questions.text:
(क) रेखाओं x/1 = (y–1)/2 = (z–2)/3 और (x–1)/0 = y/(–3) = (z–7)/2 के प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु से गुज़रने वाली उस रेखा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो इन दी गई रेखाओं के लम्बवत् है।
अथवा
(ख) एक समान्तर चतुर्भुज ABCD के दो शीर्ष A(–1, 2, 1) और B(1, –2, 5) हैं। यदि C और D से गुज़रने वाली रेखा का समीकरण (x–4)/1 = (y+7)/(–2) = (z–8)/2 है, तो भुजाओं AB और CD के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। अतः, समान्तर चतुर्भुज ABCD का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the equation of the line passing through the point of intersection of the lines x/1 = (y–1)/2 = (z–2)/3 and (x–1)/0 = y/(–3) = (z–7)/2 and perpendicular to these given lines.
OR
(b) Two vertices of the parallelogram ABCD are given as A(–1, 2, 1) and B(1, –2, 5). If the equation of the line passing through C and D is (x–4)/1 = (y+7)/(–2) = (z–8)/2, then find the distance between sides AB and CD. Hence, find the area of parallelogram ABCD.

key_points: (a) L₁: direction (1,2,3); L₂: direction (0,–3,2). Required direction = L₁×L₂ = (4+9,–(2–0),–3–0) = (13, –2, –3). Find intersection point, then form equation.
(b) AB direction: (2,–4,4), CD direction: (1,–2,2). Distance = |→AC × direction|/|direction|. Area = distance × |AB|.

questions.solution:
(a) Line L₁: x/1 = (y–1)/2 = (z–2)/3 = λ. Point: (λ, 1+2λ, 2+3λ). Line L₂: (x–1)/0 = y/(–3) = (z–7)/2 = μ. Point: (1, –3μ, 7+2μ). At intersection: λ = 1, so 1+2λ = –3μ gives 3 = –3μ, μ = –1; and 2+3λ = 5 = 7+2(–1) = 5. ✓ Intersection point P = (1, 3, 5). Direction of required line = d₁ × d₂ = (1,2,3) × (0,–3,2) = (2·2–3·(–3), 3·0–1·2, 1·(–3)–2·0) = (4+9, 0–2, –3–0) = (13, –2, –3). Equation: (x–1)/13 = (y–3)/(–2) = (z–5)/(–3).

(b) →AB = B–A = (2,–4,4). Direction of CD: (1,–2,2). Note →AB = 2(1,–2,2), so AB is parallel to CD (as expected for parallelogram). Distance between parallel lines AB and CD: Take point A(–1,2,1) on AB and point C(4,–7,8) on CD (setting parameter=0 in line equation). →AC = C–A = (5,–9,7). Unit direction of CD: d̂ = (1,–2,2)/3. Distance = |→AC × d̂| = |(–9,7,–9)×...|. →AC × (1,–2,2) = (–9×2–7×(–2), 7×1–5×2, 5×(–2)–(–9)×1) = (–18+14, 7–10, –10+9) = (–4,–3,–1). |→AC × direction| = √(16+9+1) = √26. |direction| = √(1+4+4) = 3. Distance = √26/3. |→AB| = √(4+16+16) = 6. Area = distance × |→AB| = (√26/3) × 6 = 2√26 square units.

questions.text:
स्व-अध्ययन छात्रों को सीखने में आत्मविश्वास पैदा करने में मदद करता है। इससे छात्रों का आत्म-सम्मान बढ़ता है। हाल के सर्वेक्षणों से पता चला है कि लगभग 50% छात्रों ने इंटरनेट संसाधनों का उपयोग करके स्वयं शिक्षा प्राप्त की और खुद को कुशल बनाया।

एक छात्र स्वयं के कौशल को बढ़ाने में एक दिन में 1 घंटे से 6 घंटे तक का समय व्यतीत कर सकता है। एक छात्र द्वारा व्यतीत किए गए घंटों की संख्या का प्रायिकता बंटन नीचे दिया गया है:
P(X = x) = kx², x = 1, 2, 3 के लिए; 2kx, x = 4, 5, 6 के लिए; 0, अन्यथा
जहाँ x घंटों की संख्या को प्रदत्त करता है।
questions.text_english:
Self-study helps students to build confidence in learning. It boosts the self-esteem of the learners. Recent surveys suggested that close to 50% learners were self-taught using internet resources and upskilled themselves.

A student may spend 1 hour to 6 hours in a day in upskilling self. The probability distribution of the number of hours spent by a student is given below:
P(X = x) = kx², for x = 1, 2, 3; 2kx, for x = 4, 5, 6; 0, otherwise
where x denotes the number of hours.
questions.solution: Case-based question. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

sub_questions.text: ऊपर दिए गए प्रायिकता बंटन को प्रायिकता बंटन तालिका के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Express the probability distribution given above in the form of a probability distribution table.
sub_questions.solution:
The probability distribution table is:
| X    | 1  | 2  | 3  | 4  | 5   | 6   |
| P(X) | k  | 4k | 9k | 8k | 10k | 12k |
For x = 1: P = k(1)² = k; x = 2: P = k(4) = 4k; x = 3: P = k(9) = 9k; x = 4: P = 2k(4) = 8k; x = 5: P = 2k(5) = 10k; x = 6: P = 2k(6) = 12k.
The sum of all probabilities must equal 1: k + 4k + 9k + 8k + 10k + 12k = 44k = 1. Therefore k = 1/44.

sub_questions.text: छात्र द्वारा व्यतीत किए गए घंटों की संख्या का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the mean number of hours spent by the student.

questions.text:
एक निश्चित संख्या में जीवाणुओं का एक जीवाणु नमूना एक निश्चित समय में चरघातांकी रूप से बढ़ता हुआ देखा गया है। चरघातांकी वृद्धि मॉडल का उपयोग करके, जीवाणु के इस नमूने की वृद्धि दर की गणना की जाती है।

जीवाणुओं की वृद्धि को दर्शाने वाला अवकल समीकरण इस प्रकार दिया गया है :
dP/dt = kP, जहाँ P किसी भी समय 't' पर जीवाणुओं की जनसंख्या है।
questions.text_english:
A bacteria sample of certain number of bacteria is observed to grow exponentially in a given amount of time. Using exponential growth model, the rate of growth of this sample of bacteria is calculated.

The differential equation representing the growth of bacteria is given as:
dP/dt = kP, where P is the population of bacteria at any time 't'.
questions.solution: Case-based question. Answers provided in sub_questions.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए अवकल समीकरण का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए और इसको 't' के चरघातांकी फलन के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Obtain the general solution of the given differential equation and express it as an exponential function of 't'.
sub_questions.solution: Separating variables: dP/P = k dt. Integrating both sides: ∫dP/P = ∫k dt, giving ln P = kt + C. Exponentiating: P = e^(kt+C) = e^C · e^(kt) = Ae^(kt), where A = e^C is an arbitrary constant. This is the general solution expressed as an exponential function of t.

sub_questions.text: यदि जीवाणुओं की जनसंख्या t = 0 पर 1000 और t = 1 पर 2000 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If population of bacteria is 1000 at t = 0, and 2000 at t = 1, find the value of k.
sub_questions.solution: Using P = Ae^(kt). At t = 0, P = 1000: 1000 = A·e^0 = A, so A = 1000. At t = 1, P = 2000: 2000 = 1000·e^k, so e^k = 2, therefore k = ln 2.

questions.text:
छात्रवृत्ति एक छात्र को शिक्षा के लिए भुगतान करने में मदद करने के लिए प्रदान की जाने वाली धनराशि है। कुछ छात्रों को उनकी शैक्षणिक उपलब्धियों के आधार पर छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है, जबकि अन्य को उनकी वित्तीय आवश्यकताओं के आधार पर पुरस्कृत किया जाता है।

हर वर्ष एक स्कूल कुछ मानदंडों के आधार पर बालिकाओं और मेधावी उपलब्धि हासिल करने वालों को छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करता है। सत्र 2022–23 में, स्कूल ने कुछ छात्राओं को ₹3,000 प्रत्येक की मासिक छात्रवृत्ति और शैक्षणिक और साथ ही खेल में मेधावी उपलब्धि हासिल करने वालों को ₹4,000 प्रत्येक की मासिक छात्रवृत्ति की पेशकश की।

कुल मिलाकर, 50 छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की गई और स्कूल द्वारा छात्रवृत्तियों पर ₹1,80,000 मासिक खर्च किया गया।
questions.text_english:
A scholarship is a sum of money provided to a student to help him or her pay for education. Some students are granted scholarships based on their academic achievements, while others are rewarded based on their financial needs.

Every year a school offers scholarships to girl children and meritorious achievers based on certain criteria. In the session 2022–23, the school offered monthly scholarship of ₹3,000 each to some girl students and ₹4,000 each to meritorious achievers in academics as well as sports.

In all, 50 students were given the scholarships and monthly expenditure incurred by the school on scholarships was ₹1,80,000.
questions.solution: Case-based question. Answers provided in sub_questions.
questions.topic: Application of Matrices to solve System of Equations

sub_questions.text: दी गई सूचना को आव्यूहों का उपयोग करते हुए, बीजगणितीय रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Express the given information algebraically using matrices.

key_points: Let x = number of girl students, y = number of meritorious students

sub_questions.solution: Let x be the number of girl students and y be the number of meritorious students. The two conditions give: x + y = 50 and 3000x + 4000y = 180000. In matrix form: [[1, 1],[3000, 4000]] × [[x],[y]] = [[50],[180000]], i.e., AX = B.

sub_questions.text: जाँच कीजिए कि क्या प्राप्त हुआ आव्यूह समीकरण निकाय संगत है या नहीं।
sub_questions.text_english: Check whether the system of matrix equations so obtained is consistent or not.

key_points: Since det(A) ≠ 0, the system is consistent and has a unique solution.

sub_questions.solution: For matrix A = [[1,1],[3000,4000]], det(A) = 1×4000 – 1×3000 = 4000 – 3000 = 1000 ≠ 0. Since the determinant is non-zero, matrix A is invertible and the system has a unique solution. Therefore the system is consistent.

sub_questions.text: आव्यूहों का प्रयोग करके, स्कूल द्वारा प्रत्येक प्रकार की दी गई छात्रवृत्तियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the number of scholarships of each kind given by the school, using matrices.

key_points: X = A⁻¹B gives x = 20 (girl students) and y = 30 (meritorious students)

sub_questions.solution: A⁻¹ = (1/det A) × adj(A) = (1/1000) × [[4000, –1000],[–3000, 1000]]. X = A⁻¹B = (1/1000) × [[4000×50 + (–1000)×180000/(1000)]...]. Using Cramer's rule or direct matrix multiplication: From x + y = 50 and 3x + 4y = 180 (dividing by 1000): subtracting gives y = 30 and x = 20. The school gave 20 scholarships to girl students and 30 to meritorious achievers.

sub_questions.text: यदि छात्रवृत्ति की धनराशियाँ, जो एक बालिका को और एक मेधावी छात्र को प्रदान की गई हैं, को परस्पर बदल दिया जाए, तो स्कूल का मासिक खर्च क्या होगा ?
sub_questions.text_english: Had the amount of scholarship given to each girl child and meritorious student been interchanged, what would be the monthly expenditure incurred by the school ?

key_points: x = 20 girl students now get ₹4000 each, y = 30 meritorious get ₹3000 each

sub_questions.solution: From part (iii)(a), 20 girl students and 30 meritorious students received scholarships. If the amounts are interchanged, girl students receive ₹4,000 each and meritorious students receive ₹3,000 each. New monthly expenditure = 20 × 4000 + 30 × 3000 = 80,000 + 90,000 = ₹1,70,000.
